title: Keep a supplementary character intact at the truncation boundary
summary: A cut inside an emoji now drops the whole split pair. The strict UTF-8 encoder accepted the retained earlier emoji and the exact truncation suffix.

change.description: When a positive UTF-16 length limit falls inside a surrogate pair, the retained prefix ends before the pair.

notes: Hexadecimal units expose the lone high surrogate the parent returned. A complete pair at limit 3 and an input that fits at 4 each retained their original units.
